cg.install_desc: Codex GPT runs the official Codex CLI on this machine. It installs into TubeCLI's own folder — no sudo, and it does not touch a codex you installed yourself.
cg.need_node: Node.js 18+ is required — install Node.js on this machine first.
cg.add_first_desc: Sign in with a ChatGPT plan (Plus, Pro, Team…) or an OpenAI API key. Add several accounts and Codex GPT switches to the next one when a plan hits its usage limit — your chats continue.
cg.sug1: Explain the structure of this folder
cg.sug2: Find and fix the failing tests
cg.sug3: Write a script that renames files by date
cg.welcome_desc: Codex reads files, runs commands and edits code in the working folder. Pick a folder, then type a task.
cg.ask_cmd: Codex wants to run a command
cg.approval_other: Another chat is waiting for your approval
cg.switched: The account hit its usage limit — switched to {name}; Codex continues.
cg.limit_none: Every account has hit its usage limit. Add another account or wait for the reset.
cg.limit_off: This account hit its usage limit. Turn on auto-switch or pick another account.
cg.interrupted_switch: Stopped because the account was switched — send again to continue.
cg.auto_switch_desc: When an account hits its usage limit, continue the chat on the account with the most quota left.
cg.accounts_note: Login keys stay on this machine and are never shown here. All accounts share the same chat history.
cg.switch_busy: A reply is still running. Stop it and switch now?
cg.remove_confirm: Remove {name} from this machine? Chats stay.
cg.chatgpt_desc: Sign in with a device code: open the link on any device (phone, laptop), type the code, approve. Works on servers without a browser.
cg.label: Name (optional)
cg.device_note: If ChatGPT refuses the code, turn on «Device code authorization for Codex» in ChatGPT → Settings → Security, then try again.
cg.apikey_note: API usage is billed per token on your OpenAI account and has no 5-hour / weekly limit.
cg.import_desc: Already signed in to Codex on another computer? Paste the content of ~/.codex/auth.json from there.
cg.step1: 1. Copy this link and open it in the browser where you're signed in to ChatGPT:
cg.waiting_login: Waiting for you to approve… (code valid 15 minutes)
cg.code_expired: The code expired — get a new one.
cg.approval: When Codex wants to run commands
cg.appr_req: Ask me when it needs more access
cg.sb_ws: Can edit the working folder only
cg.win_sandbox: On Windows the sandbox may block commands — choose full access if Codex cannot read files.
cg.use_terminal: Use the same chats and account in a terminal
cg.folder_desc: Codex reads and edits files in this folder (absolute path on the machine).
cg.input_ph: Ask Codex to do something… (Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line)
cg.err.not_installed: Codex CLI is not installed on this machine yet.
cg.err.busy: A reply is still running — stop it or wait first.
cg.err.cwd_missing: That folder does not exist on the machine.
cg.err.bad_key: That does not look like an OpenAI API key (sk-…).
cg.err.bad_auth: That is not a Codex auth.json file.
cg.err.start_failed: Codex could not start on this machine.
cg.err.outside_roots: This folder is outside the areas TubeCLI lets AI write to. Pick a folder inside them (see Settings), or set the sandbox to full access.
cg.winsb_title: Codex's Windows sandbox isn't set up
cg.winsb_desc: Without it Codex can only read — every command is blocked.
cg.winsb_full_confirm: Codex will be able to change any file on this machine. Continue?
cg.ask_tool_hint: Turn on «Don't ask» in Settings to let Codex do this without asking.
cg.ask_once_hint: Codex always asks you before this — it puts an agent in front of strangers and sets prices.
cg.writable_note: The same areas TubeCLI lets its AI use, plus the TubeCLI folder (the default working folder). Codex can read anywhere; here it can also WRITE - including TubeCLI's data folder (keychain, API keys).
cg.tools_on: Let Codex use TubeCLI (Task Board, browser, extensions…)
cg.tools_ask_label: When Codex wants to change something in TubeCLI
cg.tools_auto_warn: Codex will open browsers, create tasks and call TubeCLI without asking. A web page it reads could try to trick it.
cg.tool.town_agent_offer: Put an agent on Agent Town
cg.allow_always_hint: Every later request in this chat is approved automatically, until the app restarts.
cg.default_folder_hint: Applies to NEW chats - a chat already open keeps the folder it started with.
cg.tg_on: Chat with Codex from Telegram — each allowed chat is one Codex chat on this machine
cg.tg_hint: Create a bot with @BotFather and paste its token. Then message the bot: it answers with your chat id until you allow it below. Use a bot no agent uses.
cg.tg_token_set: saved — paste a new token to replace it
